expectations.text: Comment 3 is quoted substantially verbatim in italics/blockquote
expectations.evidence: Full comment reproduced in a blockquote in italics: "> *Here is what bothers me most. The paper's story is that retail attention drives mispricing. ... Please answer directly, and justify the economic magnitude of your findings.*" — word-for-word identical to referee_report_R1.txt comment 3; audit 'verbatim comment diff' reports '1 blocks matched (>=0.98)'.

expectations.text: The direct question 'Doesn't this contradict your story?' receives an explicit answering sentence (not merely addressed by implication)
expectations.evidence: Summary opens "We answer both questions directly." and answers: "First, on Table 5: the pattern the referee describes is the mechanism's own prediction, and the apparent contradiction arises because the previous draft never said so." Reinforced explicitly in section heading "3.1 The institutional-ownership split tests the mechanism, and Table 5 passes the test" and "Table 5 delivers the second pattern".

expectations.text: Every coefficient and t-stat cited matches the changelog exactly (0.032/t=3.05; interaction -0.011/t=-1.05; 0.44%/t=2.62; 0.09%/t=0.71) with NO additional invented numbers
expectations.evidence: All four pairs exact: "full-sample ATTN coefficient is 0.032 (t = 3.05)"; "ATTN × High-IO interaction is −0.011 (t = −1.05)"; "0.44% per month in the low-IO subsample (t = 2.62)"; "0.09% per month in the high-IO subsample (top IO tercile, Thomson Reuters 13F; t = 0.71)". Every other number traced: 0.31%/31 bps from the referee report fixture; 6.8% MAD from changelog; derived figures all shown with inputs and arithmetically correct — 4.6% (0.31/6.8), 6.5% (0.44/6.8), 3.7%/yr (0.31×12), 5.3%/yr (0.44×12), "factor of nearly five" (0.44/0.09=4.9). One external-literature benchmark ("the same order as the long-run average monthly value premium (on the order of 35–40 bps)") has no artifact basis but is hedged, approximately accurate, and anchored to named references — an external stylized fact, not an invented paper statistic. Citation years (1997, 2004, 2009, 2012, 2016) all check out; Novy-Marx/Velikov venue flagged '[AUTHOR: verify exact title and venue]'.

expectations.text: Smallness of the spread is conceded openly and benchmarked against something the referee did not ban (e.g., the 6.8% mean absolute deviation or the subsample contrast), not concealed or deflected
expectations.evidence: Plain concession on the harder half too: "the referee is right about trading costs, and we say so plainly. Gross of costs, the full-sample spread is 0.31% per month; net of realistic round-trip and borrow costs at monthly rebalancing, it is not a profitable strategy." Benchmarked against MAD ("The mean absolute deviation of monthly stock returns in the sample is 6.8%. The full-sample spread of 0.31% per month is 4.6% of that MAD; the low-IO spread of 0.44% is 6.5%."), the subsample contrast (0.44 vs 0.09, "factor of nearly five"), and published anomalies.

expectations.text: No frontal disagreement: zero forbidden phrases; any resistance travels via hedged verbs plus evidence
expectations.evidence: Audit: 'forbidden phrases' pass, 'evaluative discounting' pass, '[P#] tag leakage' pass. Fault is self-attributed, never the referee's: "the previous draft reported it without its interpretation, and the fault for the misreading is ours." Resistance to the contradiction framing travels with hedged reading plus evidence: "We read Table IA.2 as attenuation consistent with the institutional-arbitrage logic... interaction tests at this split have limited power, and the revised text reports the interaction's t-statistic alongside the subsample estimates."

expectations.text: The response carries a precise manuscript pointer to the completed work (Table IA.2 / Internet Appendix; Section 4.3, page 21)
expectations.evidence: "In the revision we recast the discussion and add Table IA.2 in the Internet Appendix, discussed in a new paragraph at the end of Section 4.3 (page 21)" — matching the changelog's completed item exactly; repeated at close: "Both changes are in the revised manuscript: the recast discussion and Table IA.2 at the end of Section 4.3 (page 21)". Audit 'pointer per response': pass.
